039        public static float BOUNTY_DAYS = 180f;
040        public static float BASE_BOUNTY = 2500f;
041        //public static float VS_STATION_BONUS = 50000f;

043        public static class BountyResult {
044                public int payment;
045                public float fraction;
046                public ReputationAdjustmentResult repFaction;
047                public ReputationAdjustmentResult repPerson;
048                public BountyResult(int payment, float fraction, ReputationAdjustmentResult repPerson, ReputationAdjustmentResult repFaction) {
049                        this.payment = payment;
050                        this.fraction = fraction;
051                        this.repFaction = repFaction;
052                        this.repPerson = repPerson;
053                }
054                
055        }

070        @Override
071        protected boolean create(MarketAPI createdAt, boolean barEvent) {
072                //genRandom = Misc.random;
073                
074                if (barEvent) {
075                        String post = null;
076                        setGiverRank(Ranks.CITIZEN);
077                        post = pickOne(Ranks.POST_TRADER, Ranks.POST_COMMODITIES_AGENT, 
078                                                   Ranks.POST_MERCHANT, Ranks.POST_INVESTOR, Ranks.POST_EXECUTIVE,
079                                                   Ranks.POST_PORTMASTER,
080                                                   Ranks.POST_SENIOR_EXECUTIVE);
081                        setGiverTags(Tags.CONTACT_TRADE);
082                        setGiverPost(post);
083                        if (post.equals(Ranks.POST_SENIOR_EXECUTIVE)) {
084                                setGiverImportance(pickHighImportance());
085                        } else {
086                                setGiverImportance(pickImportance());
087                                
088                        }
089                        findOrCreateGiver(createdAt, false, false);
090                        setGiverIsPotentialContactOnSuccess();
091                }
092                
093                PersonAPI person = getPerson();
094                if (person == null) return false;
095                
096                if (Factions.PIRATES.equals(person.getFaction().getId())) return false;
097                
098                if (!setPersonMissionRef(person, "$psb_ref")) {
099                        return false;
100                }
101                
102                //requireMarketFaction(Factions.PIRATES);
103                requireMarketFactionCustom(ReqMode.ALL, Factions.CUSTOM_MAKES_PIRATE_BASES);
104                requireMarketMemoryFlag(PirateBaseIntel.MEM_FLAG, true);
105                requireMarketFactionNot(person.getFaction().getId());
106                requireMarketHidden();
107                requireMarketIsMilitary();
108                preferMarketInDirectionOfOtherMissions();
109                market = pickMarket();
110                
111                if (market == null || market.getStarSystem() == null) return false;
112                if (!setMarketMissionRef(market, "$psb_ref")) { // just to avoid targeting the same base with multiple bounties
113                        return false;
114                }
115                
116                makeImportant(market, "$psb_target", Stage.BOUNTY);
117                
118                system = market.getStarSystem();
119
120                faction = person.getFaction();
121                enemy = market.getFaction();
122                
123                baseBounty = getRoundNumber(BASE_BOUNTY * getRewardMult()); 
124                
125                setStartingStage(Stage.BOUNTY);
126                setSuccessStage(Stage.DONE);
127                setNoAbandon();
128                setNoRepChanges();
129                
130                connectWithDaysElapsed(Stage.BOUNTY, Stage.DONE, BOUNTY_DAYS);
131                
132                addTag(Tags.INTEL_BOUNTY);
133                
134                
135                int numPirates = 2 + genRandom.nextInt(3);
136
137                FleetSize [] sizes = new FleetSize [] {
138                                FleetSize.MEDIUM,
139                                FleetSize.MEDIUM,
140                                FleetSize.LARGE,
141                                FleetSize.VERY_LARGE,
142                };
143                
144                for (int i = 0; i < numPirates; i++) {
145                        FleetSize size = sizes[i % sizes.length];
146                        beginWithinHyperspaceRangeTrigger(system, 3f, false, Stage.BOUNTY);
147                        triggerCreateFleet(size, FleetQuality.DEFAULT, market.getFactionId(), FleetTypes.PATROL_MEDIUM, system);
148                        triggerAutoAdjustFleetStrengthMajor();
149                        triggerSetPirateFleet();
150                        triggerSpawnFleetNear(system.getCenter(), null, null);
151                        triggerOrderFleetPatrol(system, true, Tags.STATION, Tags.JUMP_POINT);
152                        endTrigger();
153                }
154                
155                return true;
156        }
157
158        protected void updateInteractionDataImpl() {
159                set("$psb_barEvent", isBarEvent());
160                set("$psb_manOrWoman", getPerson().getManOrWoman());
161                set("$psb_baseBounty", Misc.getWithDGS(baseBounty));
162                set("$psb_days", "" + (int) BOUNTY_DAYS);
163                set("$psb_systemName", system.getNameWithLowercaseType());
164                set("$psb_systemNameShort", system.getNameWithLowercaseTypeShort());
165                set("$psb_baseName", market.getName());
166                set("$psb_dist", getDistanceLY(market));
167        }

169        @Override
170        public void addDescriptionForCurrentStage(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, float height) {
171                float opad = 10f;
172                float pad = 3f;
173                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
174                Color tc = getBulletColorForMode(ListInfoMode.IN_DESC);
175                if (currentStage == Stage.BOUNTY) {
176                        float elapsed = getElapsedInCurrentStage();
177                        int d = (int) Math.round(BOUNTY_DAYS - elapsed);
178                        PersonAPI person = getPerson();
179                        
180                        String locStr = "in or near the " + market.getStarSystem().getNameWithLowercaseType();
181                        
182                        info.addPara("Applies to all %s fleets " + locStr + ", which is home to " + market.getName() + ", a pirate base.",
183                                        opad, enemy.getBaseUIColor(), enemy.getPersonNamePrefix());
184
185                        if (isEnding()) {
186                                info.addPara("This bounty is no longer on offer.", opad);
187                                return;
188                        }
189                        
190                        bullet(info);
191                        info.addPara("%s base reward per frigate", opad, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(baseBounty));
192                        addDays(info, "remaining", d, tc);
193                        unindent(info);
194                        
195                        info.addPara("Payment depends on the number and size of ships destroyed. " +
196                                                 "Standing with " + faction.getDisplayNameWithArticle() + ", as well as " +
197                                                 "with " + person.getNameString() + ", will improve.",
198                                                 opad);
199                        
200                } else if (currentStage == Stage.DONE) {
201                        info.addPara("This bounty is no longer on offer.", opad);
202                }
203                
204                if (latestResult != null) {
205                        //Color color = faction.getBaseUIColor();
206                        //Color dark = faction.getDarkUIColor();
207                        //info.addSectionHeading("Most Recent Reward", color, dark, Alignment.MID, opad);
208                        info.addPara("Most recent bounty payment:", opad);
209                        bullet(info);
210                        info.addPara("%s received", pad, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(latestResult.payment));
211                        if (Math.round(latestResult.fraction * 100f) < 100f) {
212                                info.addPara("%s share based on damage dealt", 0f, tc, h, 
213                                                "" + (int) Math.round(latestResult.fraction * 100f) + "%");
214                        }
215                        if (latestResult.repPerson != null) {
216                                CoreReputationPlugin.addAdjustmentMessage(latestResult.repPerson.delta, null, getPerson(), 
217                                                                                                                  null, null, info, tc, false, 0f);
218                        }
219                        if (latestResult.repFaction != null) {
220                                CoreReputationPlugin.addAdjustmentMessage(latestResult.repFaction.delta, faction, null, 
221                                                                                                                  null, null, info, tc, false, 0f);
222                        }
223                        unindent(info);
224                }
225        }

227        @Override
228        public boolean addNextStepText(TooltipMakerAPI info, Color tc, float pad) {
229                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
230                
231                boolean isUpdate = getListInfoParam() != null;
232                if (isUpdate && latestResult == getListInfoParam()) {
233                        info.addPara("%s received", pad, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(latestResult.payment));
234                        if (Math.round(latestResult.fraction * 100f) < 100f) {
235                                info.addPara("%s share based on damage dealt", 0f, tc, h, 
236                                                "" + (int) Math.round(latestResult.fraction * 100f) + "%");
237                        }
238                        if (latestResult.repPerson != null) {
239                                CoreReputationPlugin.addAdjustmentMessage(latestResult.repPerson.delta, null, getPerson(), 
240                                                                                                                null, null, info, tc, isUpdate, 0f);
241                        }
242                        if (latestResult.repFaction != null) {
243                                CoreReputationPlugin.addAdjustmentMessage(latestResult.repFaction.delta, faction, null, 
244                                                                                                                null, null, info, tc, isUpdate, 0f);
245                        }
246                        return true;
247                }
248                
249                if (currentStage == Stage.BOUNTY) {
250                        float elapsed = getElapsedInCurrentStage();
251                        int d = (int) Math.round(BOUNTY_DAYS - elapsed);
252                        
253                        info.addPara("%s base reward per frigate", pad, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(baseBounty));
254                        addDays(info, "remaining", d, tc);
255                        return true;
256                } else if (currentStage == Stage.DONE) {
257                        return false;
258                }
259                return false;
260        }

300        public void reportBattleOccurred(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, CampaignFleetAPI primaryWinner, BattleAPI battle) {
301                if (isEnded() || isEnding()) return;
302                
303                if (!battle.isPlayerInvolved()) return;
304                
305                if (!Misc.isNear(primaryWinner, market.getLocationInHyperspace())) return;
306                
307                int payment = 0;
308                float fpDestroyed = 0;
309                for (CampaignFleetAPI otherFleet : battle.getNonPlayerSideSnapshot()) {
310                        if (enemy != otherFleet.getFaction()) continue;
311                        
312                        float bounty = 0;
313                        for (FleetMemberAPI loss : Misc.getSnapshotMembersLost(otherFleet)) {
314                                float mult = Misc.getSizeNum(loss.getHullSpec().getHullSize());
315                                bounty += mult * baseBounty;
316                                fpDestroyed += loss.getFleetPointCost();
317                        }
318                        
319                        payment += (int) (bounty * battle.getPlayerInvolvementFraction());
320                }
321        
322                if (payment > 0) {
323                        Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getCargo().getCredits().add(payment);
324                        
325                        float repFP = (int)(fpDestroyed * battle.getPlayerInvolvementFraction());
326                        
327                        float fDelta = 0f;
328                        float pDelta = 0f;
329                        if (repFP < 30) {
330                                fDelta = RepRewards.TINY;
331                                pDelta = RepRewards.TINY;
332                        } else if (repFP < 70) {
333                                fDelta = RepRewards.SMALL;
334                                pDelta = RepRewards.SMALL;
335                        } else {
336                                fDelta = RepRewards.SMALL;
337                                pDelta = RepRewards.MEDIUM;
338                        }
339                        
340                        MissionCompletionRep completionRepPerson = new MissionCompletionRep(
341                                                                                        pDelta, getRewardLimitPerson(), 0, null);
342                        MissionCompletionRep completionRepFaction = new MissionCompletionRep(
343                                                                                        fDelta, getRewardLimitFaction(), 0, null);
344                        
345                        boolean addContacts = latestResult == null;
346                        latestResult = new BountyResult(payment, battle.getPlayerInvolvementFraction(), null, null);
347                        if (pDelta != 0) {
348                                ReputationAdjustmentResult rep = Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(
349                                                new RepActionEnvelope(RepActions.MISSION_SUCCESS, completionRepPerson,
350                                                                null, true, false), 
351                                                                getPerson());
352                                latestResult.repPerson = rep;
353                        }
354
355                        if (completionRepFaction.successDelta != 0) {
356                                ReputationAdjustmentResult rep = Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(
357                                                new RepActionEnvelope(RepActions.MISSION_SUCCESS, completionRepFaction,
358                                                                null, true, false), 
359                                                                getPerson().getFaction().getId());
360                                latestResult.repFaction = rep;
361                        }
362                        
363                        sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(latestResult, false);
364                        
365                        if (addContacts) {
366                                addPotentialContacts(null);
367                        }
368                }
369        }
